rationale: Record the third durable finding as knowledge: where the singleton shortcut cannot apply, a ReadIndex request accepted by a removed leader is lost with the leadership, without an answer and without a refusal.

knowledge.statement: If a ReadIndex request reaches a still-leading but removed node whose configuration has more than one voter, the singleton shortcut does not apply, so the request is taken into readOnly (the leader adds it and broadcasts heartbeats) and is answered only if the round completes. When the leadership then ends - the removed leader learns of the higher term from a voter that answers a lower-term message, or its own read-only round cannot reach the configuration's quorum - whatever it accepted is gone: no ReadState, nothing left pending or unconfirmed, and no refusal signalled to the caller, so an application that treats acceptance as a promise waits out its own deadline, and only one that retries unconditionally recovers.
knowledge.conditions: ReadOnlySafe; a leading node that the application removed from the configuration while Config.StepDownOnRemoval is false; the reduced configuration has more than one voter; the request is delivered while the removed leader's committed entry is from its own term (so the postpone path is not taken).
